description: Experience elevated living in this light-filled top-floor end-unit condo in one of Encino’s most desirable communities. This expansive two-bedroom home offers a seamless flow between living and dining spaces, ideal for refined entertaining, along with generously proportioned bedrooms for ultimate comfort. Unwind with stunning sunset views and enjoy resort-style amenities including a pristine pool and spa. Complete with two assigned parking spaces and located just moments from Ventura Boulevard’s upscale dining, boutiques, and entertainment this is sophisticated Encino living redefined.
